feeds.title: Sustainable UC Davis
feeds.description: Sustainability at UC Davis has a long history connected to their academic and public service work. Their dedicated staff of health has helped expand campus sustainability through long-term planning, implementation, assessment, and engagement work. Visit their blog and learn more about classes, programs, events, news, resources, and more.

feeds.title: USC Center for Sustainability Solutions
feeds.description: The USC Center for Sustainability Solutions leverages elevates, and enhances its existing sustainability-related teaching, research, and outreach to position itself as the preeminent partner for international agencies, national and local governments, corporations, and non-governmental organizations to develop solutions to the most pressing urban environmental challenges, and advance the United Nation's Sustainable Development Goals. Explore more through their blog about sustainability.

feeds.title: IoES Magazine
feeds.description: Visit the IoES blog that promises solutions for the broader world - and publishes its newest ideas, projects, news, articles, updates, and more about sustainability.

feeds.title: Marin Magazine » Sustainability
feeds.description: Get into their blog and learn more about sharp, insightful writing, stunning photography, and artwork, informed on the hot new trends, the latest fashion, home ideas, the most noteworthy social events, and all the cultural richness of Marin, San Francisco, and beyond. Marin Magazine is the single best resource for reaching the region's most affluent readers. Their mission is to bring the lives and lifestyles of Marin together into one beautiful package, uncovering history and tradition, finding out what's new and innovative, and building community, one reader at a time.

feeds.title: Environment California
feeds.description: Environment California works for clean air, clean water, clean energy, wildlife and open spaces, and a livable climate. Their members across the state put grassroots support behind their research and advocacy. They envision a greener California, one that protects more places where nature can thrive, and offers them and their children a greater opportunity to live healthier, more enriching lives. Explore more through their blog about the latest news, events, careers, resources, and more.

feeds.title: Gallant Blog
feeds.description: Gallant International Inc., was established in 2009. They help corporates, brands, and nonprofits on their sustainable journey by supplying the highest quality customizable organic, regenerative organic, and fairtrade certified cotton products. Their mission is to create organic and fair trade cotton products for individuals, businesses, and non-profits that make the world a better place by always being sustainable, ethical, traceable, and transparent. Visit their blog and learn more about their products, articles, tips, press releases, and more.

feeds.title: Luci's Morsels Blog
feeds.description: Luci is the creator and voice behind Luci's Morsels. She is a wife, mother, and daughter. Passionate about living happily and sustainably, she shares her journey through making long-lasting choices for style, food, travel, and family. She seeks to make a sustainable lifestyle stylish and doable for everyone, especially women. Browse their blog about comfortably chic style, delicious recipes, sustainable living tips, and more on sustainability.

feeds.title: Going Zero Waste Blog
feeds.description: Kathryn is the founder of Going Zero Waste Blog and author of 101 Ways to Go Zero Waste. She focuses on the health and wellness of self and the planet. Her positivity is infectious, inspiring you to make a change big or small. Take a walk through their blog and learn more about their lifestyle, tips, news, articles, resources, fashion, beauty, and more.

feeds.title: The Good Trade
feeds.description: The Good Trade is the premier digital destination for sustainable fashion and lifestyle content and a trusted resource for vetted shopping recommendations. The articles here provide a helpful starting point in the journey towards a sustainable life. Explore trending fashion, tips for mindful living, articles, recent news, careers, and more.

feeds.title: USFCA Sustainability Blog
feeds.description: The University of San Francisco community holds several core principles, including stewardship and respect for the environment. This blog was started by the Office of Sustainability as a central resource for sustainable education to advance those ideals. Wade through their blog and learn more about news, articles, and more on sustainability.

feeds.title: California Green Business Network Blog
feeds.description: The California Green Business Program leads the state and nation in working with small to medium-sized businesses to grow a vibrant and healthy green economy. Led by a coalition of cities and counties, they contribute to more livable communities with healthier environments, while also conserving resources and saving money. Get into their blog and learn more about green business, tips, the latest news, and more.

feeds.title: UCLA Sustainability Blog
feeds.description: The UCLA Sustainability Committee is a dedicated group of faculty, staff, and students working collaboratively to advance sustainable practices and initiatives across the campus. Explore the stories of local champions driving climate action on UCLA's campuses, sustainability news, campus announcements, job opportunities, and more from their blog.

feeds.title: Streetsblog California » Sustainability
feeds.description: Dive into their blog and learn more about the latest news, articles, and information about sustainable transportation, livable communities, and more. Streetsblog has covered the movement to transform our cities by reducing dependence on private automobiles and improving conditions for pedestrians, cyclists, and transit riders. Their reporters have broken important stories about transit funding, pedestrian safety, and bicycle policy from day one.

feeds.title: USC Today » Sustainability
feeds.description: Dive into their blog and learn more about news, events, careers, academics, and more. The USC Competes Moonshot aims to make USC a destination of choice that attracts the best and brightest, and where faculty, staff, and students can thrive and achieve their dreams.

feeds.title: GreenCitizen » Sustainable Living
feeds.description: Go through their blog and learn more about informative articles, the latest news, services, and more on sustainable living. GreenCitizen is a socially responsible company driven to provide everyone with actionable information and services so that everyone can live a sustainable life. Its mission is to make every day Earth Day. And, they proudly say that they've stayed true to their mission every day of their exciting journey and are determined to continue in the years to come.

feeds.title: This Is My Happiness
feeds.description: This Is My Happiness is a travel and lifestyle blog focused on sustainable, responsible choices. The author of this blog is passionate about making responsible choices that put less pressure on the environment and loves sharing that with others. Check out their blog and learn more about tips for sustainable travel and lifestyle, traveling responsibly, inspiration for traveling with kids, an appreciation for history and culture, and more.

feeds.title: Inhabitat
feeds.description: Inhabitat is a green design and lifestyle site that provides coverage of environmental news and the latest in sustainable design. Their website is devoted to the future of design, innovative technology, and any architectural projects or concepts that emphasize energy efficiency, sustainability, and connection to the surrounding environment. Go through their blog and learn more about the latest news, designs, lifestyle, and more.
